title: Core: AS2 XMLSocket and LoadVars built-ins
description: Test compilation of XMLSocket: var xs = new XMLSocket(), xs.connect(host, port), xs.send(data), xs.close(), xs.onConnect = function(ok){}, xs.onData = function(s){}. Test LoadVars: var lv = new LoadVars(), lv.load(url), lv.sendAndLoad(url, target), lv.onLoad = function(ok){}, lv.loaded. Each should compile without error. Document actual opcodes emitted (ActionNew 0x4a, ActionCallMethod 0x52, ActionSetMember 0x4e).
